title: Candidate freeze: final qualification, baseline pointer and gate evidence
summary: Freezes the 1.0 candidate: switches every remaining 'after P4' invariant to blocking now and fixes the CHANGELOG date in commit C; qualifies C completely (local V-list and GitHub Actions incl. Compatibility and nightly on feat/1.0-candidate); then a commit that only sets `compatibility.json` `candidate` = C, re-runs api:compat, the drill against C and release-preflight 1.0.0, and writes `gate.md` mapping each amended release condition to its evidence; hands the tag commands to the owner.
why: Phase V1 and exit criterion: the documented gate satisfied on one candidate commit with linked evidence; condition 10 'the candidate becomes the compatibility baseline'; D27 leaves the tag to the owner. Hard risks: code landing between qualification and pointer (then C is not what was qualified) — the pointer commit may touch only compatibility.json and plan files; production code changed after the P4.6 bench without re-running it; CI evidence from a different sha than the local runs.

include: `tests/Arch/invariants.json`: every entry `status: exists`, `blocking: now` (I9, I18, I19, I22 and all 'after Pn'); CHANGELOG `[1.0.0]` date = the freeze date; commit = C
Full qualification of C: V1–V10 locally, push C (owner gate CI-PUSH), dispatch nightly, V11 CI check including `Compatibility`; any failure → demonstrated fix (convention 1), new C, repeat
Freeze dependency of p4-execution#load: if production code changed after the last P4.6 commit, re-run the affected bench pairs on C
Commit C+1: `compatibility.json` `candidate` = C only; `composer api:compat`; `bash bin/compat-drill.sh --baseline=C`; `bash bin/release-preflight.sh 1.0.0 HEAD`; push C+1 and check its CI (V15)

`plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/gate.md`: one row per amended condition (p4-execution#gate) with evidence paths, CI run URLs, sha and verdict; plus I19 and the drill

Item result: exact owner commands `git tag -a v1.0.0 <C+1> -m "AzGuard 1.0.0"` and `git push origin v1.0.0`, and the reminders: split one-time setup (RELEASING.md), label `compat-baseline`, branch protection requiring Tests/Compatibility

reads.why: Rules every P4 item follows: demonstrated fixes only, stop rule for frozen contracts, 1.0 starting point, owner WIP, pushes, long runs, evidence
Exact commands, PHP 8.4 shim, driver ports, composer update rule, CI evidence procedure
The amended release conditions and which evidence this item contributes
Original ten conditions and CI rules; read together with p4-execution#gate (amended rows win)
Invariant ids, their checks and statuses
Pointer rules (a commit cannot name itself; the pointer commit touches nothing else)
Freeze dependency on the P4.6 bench
Release procedure the owner follows after the plan

rules: Do not stage, revert or overwrite the owner's uncommitted files (p4-execution#conventions item 6); commit only the item's paths.
C+1 changes only compatibility.json (plus plan bookkeeping); verify with `git diff --name-only C HEAD`.
Acceptance evidence names C (V1–V12) or C+1 (V13–V15) explicitly.
guidance: Sequence strictly: commit C → local long runs on C (detached) and push C in parallel → wait for both → only if all green write C+1. Record `C=$(git rev-parse HEAD)` in qualification.md before starting. The CI check of C must include `Compatibility` (it compares C with the provisional pointer from P4.3).

SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && OUT=plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/ci-runs-$SHA.json && gh run list --commit "$SHA" --limit 100 --json databaseId,workflowName,event,headSha,status,conclusion,url > "$OUT" && python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); need=set(sys.argv[2].split(",")); ok={x["workflowName"] for x in r if x["conclusion"]=="success"}; bad=[x for x in r if x["workflowName"] in need and x["conclusion"]!="success"]; sys.exit(0 if need<=ok and not bad else 1)' "$OUT" "Tests,Static Analysis,Code Style,Zizmor,CodeQL,Compatibility,Tests (nightly)"
python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open("tests/Arch/invariants.json")); bad=[e["id"] for e in d if e["status"]!="exists" or e["blocking"]!="now"]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)'
validation.expect: exit 0 (every invariant exists and blocks now)

validation.cmd: C=$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("compatibility.json"))["candidate"])') && test "$(git diff --name-only $C HEAD -- . ':!plans')" = compatibility.json && composer api:compat && bash bin/compat-drill.sh --baseline=$C
validation.expect: exit 0 on C+1: pointer-only commit, compatible, drill rejects every break

deliverables: Frozen candidate C and pointer commit C+1

authority.scope: Push the local HEAD to origin refs/heads/feat/1.0-candidate (force-with-lease only on that branch) and dispatch tests-nightly.yml on it, to obtain GitHub Actions evidence; never main, never tags.
